chunks: He said to the chiefs around him: "He is certainly a clever magician."

key_terms.لِلْمَلَإِ: the chiefs or assembly of leaders

ai.seo_question: What did Pharaoh say to his chiefs about Musa (AS)?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Ash-Shu'ara, Pharaoh labels Musa (AS) a 'skilled magician' to delegitimize the divine signs before his elite council, a tactic reflecting the ancient Near Eastern tendency to attribute miraculous power to occult arts rather than prophethood. Shia exegesis highlights this as a strategic political move to maintain the status quo, where the elite prioritize social order and royal authority over spiritual truth, ultimately leading to the dismissal of Musa's message as mere sorcery.
